question: Change the Rules field in networkingv1.IngressSpec (k8s.io/api/networking/v1) from []IngressRule to a new named type IngressRuleList with different accessor methods. Ingress.Spec.Rules is the primary field that ingress controllers, cert managers, and DNS providers iterate to extract hostnames, paths, and backend configurations. Any code that ranges over ingress.Spec.Rules or appends to it as a plain slice will break.
